name: MAI-DS-R1

lifecycle.note: Weights remain downloadable from Microsoft's Hugging Face organisation (checked 2026-10-01). The hosted API on Microsoft Foundry was retired on 2026-02-27 (see milestones).

dates.note: No retired date is recorded because the open weights stay available; the Foundry-hosted API retirement is a milestone.

date.note: Suggested replacement on the page: any DeepSeek model available in the model catalog.

summary.text: MAI-DS-R1 is an open-weights reasoning model released by Microsoft on 17 April 2025: a version of DeepSeek-R1 that the Microsoft AI team post-trained to answer topics the original blocked and to improve its risk profile. The weights are on Hugging Face under the MIT licence; the hosted API on Azure AI Foundry was retired on 27 February 2026.

sources.locator: Model Architecture and Objective: Pre-trained Model Base

parameters.note: Microsoft states no parameter count for MAI-DS-R1 itself; the model card gives 671B only as the size of the pre-trained base model, DeepSeek-R1, from another organisation.

access.note: At release: Azure AI Foundry hosted API and Hugging Face weights, including quantized versions. The Foundry API was retired on 2026-02-27.

notes: Added outside the decided scope: a DeepSeek-R1 model post-trained by the Microsoft AI team, released with open weights. Its base model belongs to another organisation; that derived-from link is not recorded here. Named MAI but not trained end to end by Microsoft AI, which calls MAI-1-preview its first such foundation model.
